item.title: [Global][Identity, Security & Operations] - Logs Data Platform maintenance notification
item.description:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Dec 17, 13:00 - 19:00 UTC

Sep 30, 15:05 UTC
Scheduled - As part of our continuous improvement plan, a maintenance is scheduled on our Logs Data Platform offer.

Start time : 17/12/2026 13:00 UTC
End time : 17/12/2026 19:00 UTC
Service impact : On the afternoon of December 17, 2026, we will permanently decommission the legacy authentication system for Logs Data Platform and transition fully to OVH’s IAM (Identity and Access Management).

Workaround : This new authentication system has been in place for more than a year, giving us confidence in its stability and reliability.

Please ensure that all your identities, roles, and tokens are migrated to OVH’s IAM before this date.

To help you complete the migration, please refer to the following guides:

- https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/manage-and-operate/observability/logs-data-platform/iam-presentation-faq
- https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/manage-and-operate/observability/logs-data-platform/iam-access-management
- https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/manage-and-operate/observability/logs-data-platform/iam-migration

Please make sure to complete the migration before December 17, 2026 to avoid any disruption to your access to Logs Data Platform.

Service improvement : As part of our continuous improvement policy, we will be doing a maintenance on our Logs Data Platform infrastructure.

Thank you for your understanding.

Customers who have already installed one of these operating systems may continue to use it, but will no longer be able to reinstall it.
